limitations: Structural review found 74 placemarks, 74 unique ward names in ExtendedData, 83 polygon components, 83 coordinate rings, zero unclosed rings, zero malformed coordinate tuples, and zero coordinates outside legal longitude/latitude ranges. CI acquisition retrieved a 533,483-byte KML with SHA-256 e6376e6a2ac3a0ab28615cd77f4d649bfba5c48034d26c2e31ae295697d06238. Structural checks: 74 placemarks, 74 unique ward names in ExtendedData, 83 polygon components, 83 rings, zero unclosed rings, zero malformed coordinate tuples, and zero out-of-range coordinates.

A full projected geometry comparison (EPSG:32643) found both geometries valid and the ward union valid, but substantial disagreement: candidate ward union 79.0992 km², configured provisional boundary 96.1376 km², intersection 77.3049 km², symmetric difference 20.6271 km², intersection-over-union 0.78937324, and symmetric-difference fraction 0.21062676. This is not a minor boundary discrepancy; do not replace either geometry or use the candidate for exposure masking until source identity and final official notification alignment are resolved.

Candidate bounds [76.2370672, 9.8930813, 76.3399039, 10.0502655] differ from the configured boundary bounds [76.2373589, 9.8897183, 76.3400293, 10.0497693]; the approximate edge differences are 32 m west, 374 m south, 14 m east, and 55 m north. Extent differences are supplementary to the full geometry mismatch.
The official Cochin map page is labelled Draft Notification; final legal boundary alignment and source-specific positional accuracy are not established.

Do not promote this candidate to the production boundary or use it for exposure analysis until the geometry discrepancy, source identity, final official notification, and applicable reuse terms are resolved.
